title: CryBackpacks RP
description: The official vanilla-friendly 3D resource pack for the CryBackpacks plugin. Required to display custom backpack models on your server.
body:
# 📦 CryBackpacks — Official Resource Pack

Welcome to the official 3D resource pack specifically designed for the **CryBackpacks** plugin! 

This pack contains high-quality, vanilla-friendly 3D models crafted in Blockbench for all tiers of backpacks (Leather, Iron, and Gold).

---

## ⚠️ Important Note
This is **NOT** a standalone resource pack. It does not replace any default Minecraft items. It is designed exclusively to work alongside the **CryBackpacks** server plugin using modern 1.21.4+ item components.

To make the backpacks appear in your game, you must have the plugin installed on your server!

---

## 🔗 Download the Plugin
If you haven't installed the server-side plugin yet, you can get it here:
👉 [Download CryBackpacks Plugin](https://modrinth.com/plugin/crybackpacks)

---

## 🚀 Installation
1. Download this `.zip` file.
2. For **Singleplayer/Testing:** Move it into your `resourcepacks` folder and activate it in-game.
3. For **Servers:** Upload it to your host, generate a direct download link, and set it as your server's required resource pack so your players download it automatically!
